The Christmas MP3 is a Blizzard Holiday Skit that was released on December 23, 2004 (exactly one month after the release of World of Warcraft) as a downloadable MP3 file on Blizzard's website. It is roughly 8 and a half minutes long and features the Invincible Legion of Unconquerable Vanquishing Gnomes in their second appearance as they apply for seasonal work in the workshop of the mysterious (and, as it turns out, sinister) Santa. Despite coinciding with the introduction of the Feast of Winter Veil in patch 1.2 (December 18, 2004), the skit uses the real-world terms "Christmas" and "Santa" instead of "Winter Veil" and "Greatfather Winter".

, a chloroceros in Harandar.]] Chloroceros are rhino-like florafaun found in Harandar. One can deduce a chloroceros's health by its foliage; the healthier the chloroceros, the more vivid the foliage. Catching a chloroceros' mane leaf midair is considered a sign of good luck among the Haranir. The more vivacious the leaf, the greater the luck. The orchid hydra's favorite food is the violet-horned chloroceros, especially the buds on the bull's back. Chloroceros bones are used as a base for haranir weapons.

, a cinderbee in the Cinderwold.]] Cinderbees (or fire bees) are bee-like elementals that live in the Cinderwold on the Isle of Dorn. The earthen on the isle harvest their fire honey (a source of elemental fire, organic and untainted) to make cinderbrew. Stunning yet perilous creatures, their tempers are as hot as their flames. When their numbers surge, honey production halts, triggering extreme aggression instead. It is then necessary to cull their population to calm them down and guide them back to their honey-making duties. Their pollen is highly explosive. Chua is a haranir child located at the Den in Harandar. At some point, his older brother En'liahn saved him from the Rift of Aln. En'liahn was presumed dead afterward. Chua later returned to the Rift of Aln to confront En'liahn for running away from him. En'liahn told him that he had self-exiled out of fear that he was dangerous; the rift had corrupted his connection to the goddess, driving him mad. The human storyline is one of the longest storylines in , spanning from Elwynn Forest to endgame. The Kingdom of Stormwind and its House of Nobles are embroiled in political intrigue, and the kingdom's most major problems all seem to be connected... but by what? The full storyline can only be completed in or . "The Great Masquerade" quest chain was removed in patch 3.0.2, and nearly everything else was removed in patch 4.0.3a. As a side note, a continuation was added to "The Missing Diplomat" quest chain in patch 2.3, but the added quests are set later in the timeline and will spoil parts of The Great Masquerade.

This article consists of Classic mounts unique to their experiences and did not exist in the original experiences. This takes the place of Wrathion's legendary cloaks from . The equip effect increases stats by a scaling amount based on the amount of threads returned. At various thresholds (marked by achievements), those threads will also carry over to newly-created Pandaria Remix characters. Stats shown here are example stats on the website, and will vary in normal gameplay. Clive DelGizmo is a goblin located in the inn of Camp Murroch in south-central Ringing Deeps. Shoeduck is behind him. Clive was interested in working in the Dread Pit and wanted to find a new name for it. He was approached by Danagh, who was seeking his mentor Foreman Arbauch, but Clive wanted to trade the information for killing fog beasts first. With the help of an adventurer, the fog beasts were dispersed, and Clive directed Danagh to the underground of Murroch. Cliffside Beacon is dawntower location in north-central Hallowfall. Players are initially directed here in Shadow upon Shadow. The tower is on top of the Gloomcrag Bower, and is bordered by Sina's Yearning to the north, Hillhelm Stead to the northeast, Rumshackle to the east, the Fangs to the southeast, the Hungering Pool to the southwest, and Lorel's Crossing to the west.
